dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Newly diagnosed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS, presenting as a left axillary nodal mass (excisional biopsy 2026-08-25). Non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by Hans algorithm

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is a new lymphoma, not a breast cancer recurrence: AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative in the lesional cells, there is no carcinoma morphology, and the immunophenotype is lymphoid.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor stage III-B-S (Lugano stage III). Disease above and below the diaphragm

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: spleen counted as a nodal/lymphoid site, so S modifier and not stage IV

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms present: fevers to 38.4 C, 38.2 C on 2026-09-15, and drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: largest mass is the 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate on PET, below the 10 cm Lugano bulky threshold but at the 7.5 cm threshold used in some protocols

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic nodules were judged extranodal the stage would be IV, which would change the IPI by one point; I do not think that reading applies here.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor phenotype (MYC IHC 45%, BCL2 IHC 70%). Interphase FISH negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: No MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement by FISH, so it does not meet the double-hit definition and does not by itself indicate DA-EPOCH-R.

mn_da_epoch.quote: so it does not meet the double-hit definition and does not by itself indicate DA-EPOCH-R.

prog_ipi_2.quote: Classic IPI 2 (low-intermediate): age 59 (0), LDH elevated (1), stage III (1), ECOG 1 (0), extranodal sites 0 (1 if the spleen is counted, which would give IPI 3, intermediate).

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (intermediate): LDH elevated (1) and stage III (1); age 59 (not >60), ECOG 1, and normal kidneys and adrenals score 0.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate) is not indicated on current criteria; the methotrexate toxicity would add to her cardiac and treatment burden without a clear net benefit.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal methotrexate or high-dose methotrexate) is not indicated on current criteria

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: No anthracycline-containing regimen (R-CHOP-21, pola-R-CHP or DA-EPOCH-R) should be given at this time. Her LVEF has fallen from 62% (2016) to 45% with GLS -14%

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: Curative intent, R-CHOP-type therapy is not recommended for her now.

tx_cardioprotection.quote: Start guideline-directed heart failure therapy now, even though she is asymptomatic (stage B LV dysfunction): ACE inhibitor, ARB or ARNI (preferred for BP and LV function), an evidence-based beta-blocker

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: My decision is an anthracycline-free regimen: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg, rituximab 375 mg/m2, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2, vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 (max 2 mg), and prednisone

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: the anthracycline-free regimen probably carries a somewhat lower cure rate than standard therapy

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: echocardiogram with GLS before cycle 1 (after 2-3 weeks of GDMT), repeated after cycle 3 and at the end of treatment, and sooner for symptoms or troponin/NT-proBNP rise.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 3-6 weeks after cycle 6, with Deauville 1-3 defining complete metabolic response; a residual Deauville 4-5 with suspicion of progression needs biopsy before any change.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: TLS: intermediate risk (bulky disease, elevated LDH, rituximab-chemotherapy). Use allopurinol (or febuxostat) from day -1, with low-volume hydration because of the LV dysfunction; reserve rasburicase for elevated uric acid.

sup_gcsf.quote: I would give primary G-CSF from cycle 1 (pegfilgrastim or biosimilar, day 2 or later).

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: continue to the planned 10-year endpoint (November 2026) for breast cancer; it has no meaningful interaction with the lymphoma regimen

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs are nonreactive, so no antiviral prophylaxis is required for rituximab; HBV vaccination is recommended, ideally before cycle 1

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: ECOG 1, NYHA class I, independent in all activities, working full hours, and walking two flights of stairs without stopping; her overall fitness supports curative-intent therapy.

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Echocardiogram and GLS values were reported but no repeat LVEF; no cardiac MRI, ECG, troponin or NT-proBNP are in the record; no coronary assessment
